entries.human_semantics: Initialize the array header from the low word of the supplied count or capacity, resize two-byte code-unit storage through the accepted array model, and return the full array pointer after restoring the live save slots.
entries.boundary: The accepted 8229F678 ResizeArray model preserves its real manager initialization and vtable+8 service contract, but its generic lower ABI does not expose every volatile register, condition bit, or native callback effect. Faults, MMIO, concurrency and runtime integration remain unverified.
